messages.author: Sayan Poddar
messages.body:
Dear AMBER developers and Users,
I am receiving this warning message during PCA run through cpptraj
*--  [hist amd_exp:1 amd_exp:2 min -150 max 150 bins 72 free 300 out
amd_exp_free.dat] Calculating step from min=-150 max=150 bins=72. Dim
amd_exp:1: -150.000000->150.000000, step 4.166667, 72 bins. Calculating
step from min=-150 max=150 bins=72. Dim amd_exp:2: -150.000000->150.000000,
step 4.166667, 72 bins. Hist: 10000 data points in each dimension. Hist:
Allocating histogram, total bins = 5184 Warning: Frame 1 Coordinates out of
bounds (-1) Warning: Frame 2 Coordinates out of bounds (-1) Warning: Frame
3 Coordinates out of bounds (-1) Warning: Frame 4 Coordinates out of bounds
(-1)*
*........*
* Warning: Frame 5667 Coordinates out of bounds (-1) Warning: Frame 5668
Coordinates out of bounds (-1) Warning: Frame 5669 Coordinates out of
bounds (-1) Histogram: Calculating free E at 300.000000 K.           Bins
max is 74           Artificial ceiling (bin pop = 0.5) is 2.979144
kcal/mol.TIME: Analyses took 0.0181 seconds.*
Although I am getting the result in the end. But what is the meaning of
this warning?
*with regards*
*Sayan Poddar*
*PhD Research Scholar*
*Department of Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering*
*Indian Institute of Technology Indore*
*India*

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Some of the values you are trying to bin are outside the min and max
you have set. Admittedly the error message should be much clearer as
to what the problematic values are, but trying using the 'avg'
analysis command to look at the minimum and maximum values of what you
are trying to bin, e.g.
runanlysis avg amd_exp:1 amd_exp:2 out avg.dat
Hope this helps,
-Dan
